rows.grounds: present passive participle describing one subjected to cutting
passive optative expressing potential or actual non-effect of cutting
compound indicating one who has reached or merged with that state
compound indicating one whose mind is absorbed in that
introduces the condition or manner of the subject

items.question: Can a person absorbed in that state be harmed when physically cut?
premises: A person may be subjected to the act of cutting.
That person has gone to that state and has the mind fixed on that.
Absorption in that state prevents the effect of being cut.
items.inference: One whose being and mind are absorbed in that remains unaffected by cutting.
uncertainties: The referent of 'that' (tat) is implicit from the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: Even while being cut, one is not cut, as one who has gone to that and whose mind is fixed on that.
